questions.q: What did the crew see when the fog lifted?
choices: Two low hills and a third, higher hill behind
A pirate ship lying at anchor in the mouth of the bay
A lighthouse standing on a high cliff
A wide sandy beach lined with palm trees
questions.evidence: we saw two low hills, about a couple of miles apart

questions.q: When the captain asked if anyone had seen the island before, who answered?
choices: Silver
Israel Hands
Dick
Job Anderson

questions.q: Why was the big main hill called the Spy-glass, according to Silver?
choices: Pirates kept a lookout there while cleaning ships
It was shaped exactly like a long telescope
Flint lost his favourite spy-glass on it
It was named after Silver's tavern in Bristol
questions.evidence: by reason of a lookout they kept when they was in the anchorage cleaning

questions.q: Why was Silver disappointed when he looked at the captain's chart?
choices: It was a copy without the red crosses and notes
It showed a different island far away to the south of this one
It was torn and too faded to read
It was all written in Spanish
questions.evidence: with the single exception of the red crosses and the written notes

questions.q: How did Silver handle his annoyance about the chart?
choices: He hid it and praised the chart
He threw the chart overboard
He accused the captain of lying
He stormed off below deck
questions.evidence: Silver had the strength of mind to hide it

questions.q: Jim says he had a horror of Silver's "cruelty, duplicity, and power." What does "duplicity" mean?
choices: Deceitfulness, pretending to be one thing while being another
Great strength of body, enough to beat any man in a fight
A bad and fiery temper that flares up at small things
Clumsiness, always tripping over things and dropping them

questions.q: How did Silver treat Jim after handing back the chart?
choices: Kindly, offering to pack him a snack for exploring
Coldly, turning his back and ignoring him
Angrily, threatening him with his crutch
Suspiciously, asking him where he had been all afternoon long
questions.evidence: he'll put up a snack for you to take along

questions.q: What did Jim ask Dr. Livesey to do when he got the chance to speak quietly?
choices: Get the captain and squire to the cabin, then send for him
Arrest Silver at once and lock him in the hold
Turn the ship around and sail back to Bristol
Hide the map in his coat pocket where no one could find it
questions.evidence: Get the captain and squire down to the cabin, and then make some pretence to send for me.

questions.q: Why did the doctor loudly say, "Thank you, Jim, that was all I wanted to know"?
choices: To make the crew think Jim had just answered a question
Because Jim had fetched his pipe and tobacco for him
To embarrass Jim in front of all of the crew
Because he did not believe a single word of what Jim had said
questions.evidence: as if he had asked me a question

questions.q: What sign told Jim that the doctor was agitated in the cabin?
choices: He had his wig on his lap
His hands were shaking badly
He was pacing up and down
He had stopped smoking
questions.evidence: with his wig on his lap, and that, I knew, was a sign that he was agitated

questions.q: What did the squire admit to Captain Smollett after hearing Jim's story?
choices: That the captain was right and he was wrong
That he had told Silver all about the map
That he wanted to turn back to Bristol
That he had known about the plot all along
questions.evidence: you were right, and I was wrong

questions.q: Why did the captain say they must go on instead of turning back?
choices: The crew would rise against them at once
They had almost run out of food and water
The wind was blowing the wrong way to turn
The squire refused to give up the treasure
questions.evidence: If I gave the word to go about, they would rise at once.

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: Reaching the island and the honest men planning against the mutineers
The pirates seizing the ship in the night and locking all the honest men below deck
Jim finding the treasure on the island
Silver confessing his whole plan to the captain
questions.evidence: I put prodigious faith in you
